title: Fast Exponentiation
description: Implement `pow(x, n)`, which calculates `x` raised to the power `n` (i.e., `x^n`). Round result to 4 decimal places.
output_format: Value of x^n rounded to 4 decimal places.
hints: Use binary exponentiation: if n is even, `x^n = (x^2)^(n/2)`.
If n is odd, `x^n = x * x^(n - 1)`.
If n is negative, compute `1 / pow(x, -n)`.

reference_solution:
import sys
data = sys.stdin.read().split()
if data:
    x, n = float(data[0]), int(data[1])
    res = x ** n
    print(f'{res:.4f}')
